products.name: Azure Landing Zone with Terraform — Commercial
products.short_description: Build a secure, scalable Azure foundation as code — a Terraform landing zone with management groups, policy, identity, and networking.
products.description:
Build a secure, scalable Azure foundation as code — a Terraform landing zone with management groups, policy, identity, and networking.

Clicking your way to an Azure foundation doesn't scale and drifts immediately. This solution deploys an Azure landing zone with Terraform — management group hierarchy, Azure Policy guardrails, RBAC, hub-spoke networking, logging, and a remote state + CI/CD workflow — so your cloud foundation is versioned, repeatable, and governed.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Management group hierarchy and subscription vending
  • Azure Policy guardrails (security, cost, region) as code
  • Identity & RBAC baseline and remote Terraform state
  • Hub-spoke networking, DNS, and connectivity
  • CI/CD pipeline for plan/apply with approvals and drift detection

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A governed, versioned Azure foundation deployed as code — repeatable across subscriptions with no configuration drift.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 3 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • IACTF-Discovery.ps1 — inventory the current Azure estate before landing-zone deployment (read-only)
    • IACTF-Report.ps1 — governance report: policy compliance state + Terraform drift summary (read-only)
    • IACTF-Validate.ps1 — pre/post-apply validation: state backend, plan/drift, provider pinning (plan-only)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
